summary: Completed D1 Propose: converted 032-approved Explore conclusions into formal Proposal four-artifact bundle. proposal.md defines Why (old Bootstrap fixed-pattern deviations), What Changes (4 formal output docs + capability spec + 12 frozen rules), Capabilities (new flowkit-bootstrap-and-roadmap), Impact. design.md defines 14 Decisions answering Explore Q1-Q10 and P1-P6, covering Bootstrap minimum loop, Run creation boundary (with goal change), Run file minimum content, Continuation Context generation, Git 3-boundary model (Change activation not formal), ordinary Commit principles, Review not requiring Commit, owner authorization, patterns to avoid, AGENTS/Skill boundaries, Development Roadmap, formal doc structure, delivery-lifecycle Section 10 handling, and capability naming. spec.md defines 15 Requirements with Scenarios covering all frozen conclusions. tasks.md defines 7 sections with apply-phase tasks. Per owner instruction, no Git Commit was created; all artifacts remain in working tree until Change Checkpoint.
keyConclusions: Bootstrap manually executes same Flowkit rules; no second bootstrap-only state system.
Run creation boundary includes goal change; same Run only when Action+role+goal all unchanged.
Run files save minimum content; no complete conversations; no auto-commit.
Git formal boundaries are only 3: Delivery Start, Change Checkpoint, Delivery Final.
Change activation is NOT a formal Git boundary; does not require dedicated commit.
Ordinary Commits only by real need; do not advance Flowkit state.
Review not forced to bind Git Commit; reviewedResultRef may use Run ResultRef, content hash, etc.
Owner authorization required for Apply, Archive, Full Test, Finalize, corrective Change, destructive Git.
flowkit-git-workflow Skill only executes determined Git behaviors; no process decision authority.
Development Roadmap: Deterministic Core → Change Execution Loop → Delivery Execution Loop; no Registry or plugin platform.
D1 does not modify A1, B1, or C1; true conflicts require corrective Change.

commitPolicy.reason: Per owner instruction and D1 frozen Git model: Action/Run do not auto-commit. All propose artifacts remain in working tree and will enter Git history at Change Checkpoint.
